framework: BRIDGE: Biological Routes to Interspecies Dyadic Guided Engagement
primary_question: Which partner-specific biological variables distinguish established human-dog and human-cat affiliation from general sociability, novelty, food anticipation, handling, and shared context?

design.sessions: four counterbalanced 12-minute sessions at a matched circadian window

confirmatory_endpoints: comparison of time-lagged physiological models with shared-exposure null models
exploratory_endpoints: microbiome and immune markers if pre-specified in a later amendment
prohibited_claims_without_new_evidence: that peripheral oxytocin equals brain oxytocin signaling
that a dog mechanism applies unchanged to cats
that behavioral attachment demonstrates identical subjective experience across species
welfare: Noninvasive observation only; animals may disengage; no deprivation, restraint, or hormone administration.
